items.q: Does Hinduism worship many entirely separate gods?
items.correct: Many Hindus see deities as aspects of one ultimate reality (Brahman).
items.random_wrong: Hinduism has only one named god.
items.why: Hindu thought often understands the many deities as expressions of one reality.

items.q: Does Hinduism have a single founder and one holy book?
items.correct: No — it has no single founder and many sacred texts (e.g. Vedas, Bhagavad Gita).
items.misconception: Yes, one founder and one book.
items.random_wrong: It has no texts at all.
items.why: Hinduism is ancient and highly diverse in scripture and practice.
